name: Marching Neurons
definition: An analytical method that extracts the exact zero-level set of a neural implicit function by exploiting the piecewise-linear structure of ReLU-based networks, traversing decision boundaries directly rather than sampling space.
summary: Marching Neurons is an analytical isosurface extraction method that constructs exact zero-level sets of ReLU-based neural implicit functions by traversing decision boundaries directly, eliminating grid discretization errors.
